digest.component_or_area: file-impact state model and CLI dispatch
propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded: missing third state to distinguish 'author forgot' from 'no repo file touched'; FILE_IMPACT event gains file_impact_scope (undeclared|paths|none) and no_file_impact_reason.
CLI set-file-impact must move from _REGISTRY to _ARGV_REGISTRY to support two forms: array form (unchanged) and new --none form with mandatory reason; reason requires >=10 non-whitespace characters.

Reducer derivation: non-empty file_impact→'paths', empty file_impact+payload scope='none'→'none', else→'undeclared'; last-writer-wins replacement in process_file_impact makes three states mutually exclusive.

New library function rebar.get_file_impact_scope(ticket_id) returns {kind, reason, paths}; new MCP tool declare_no_file_impact applies same reason validation and returns string ack without outputSchema.
rebar show must display file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason for declared-none tickets; get-file-impact keeps array shape and byte-for-byte current output.
State transitions (paths↔none, undeclared→any, any→undeclared) must be validated in reducer test covering all ordered pairs; CLI and MCP must reject short reasons before writing events.
